title: The search for App-iness: Building the future with Progressive Web Apps

blocks.html: Progressive Web Apps combine the best of the web and the best of apps. They load quickly, even on flaky networks, have an icon on the home screen, can re-engage with users by sending push notifications, and load as top-level, full-screen experiences. In this talk Jamie Maria Schouren explains the what, why, and how of Progressive Web Apps, her own quest in search for "app-iness" and with code examples and real-life use cases, shows why PWA’s are the future of the web!
